name: cad-to-process
description: Evidence-first foundation for translating CAD models and manufacturing drawings into governed machining process plans and objective-aware route recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: From CAD and drawings to governed machining process plans.
interface.longDescription: The process-planning link between text-to-cad and a future process-to-cam stage. It coordinates expert skills that translate CAD models, drawings, PMI, and manufacturing constraints into machining-feature evidence, feasible process-route candidates, and objective-aware recommendations. Version 0.1 establishes the auditable B-Rep, DXF, OCR, feature, and intent-fusion foundation; route planning, feasibility checking, and cost/time/value optimization remain governed extension layers.
defaultPrompt: Build an auditable part-intent manifest from these drawing files.
Inspect this STEP model for B-Rep geometry and semantic PMI.
Assess whether the fused evidence is sufficient for process-route planning and identify every blocker.
